body: Should this use the full name (ANDROID ICE COLD PROJECT) instead of the abbreviation similar to POSP above.

What's the criteria for adding all those roms? 
The Android roms ecosystem is going to continue changing; unless a specific rom has significant traction, I don't think we want to track every single addition / removal.

I came across this collection of properties because I'm trying to identify the OS for a tool I'm building and I just verified and expanded it. 
I don't have any better statistics to go by then comparing GitHub and XDA activity/popularity. 
As far as I can tell, many of the popular ROMs are LineageOS based and only a handful have gained meaningful traction in recent times, while others in this list are not being actively maintained anymore (this does not apply to any of the ones I added).
So I'm unsure how relevant this information is to begin with - on the other hand, I don't see any real downside either.
I could expand  or shrink this if need be, we could also limit it to n popular ones or set requirements like x devices, y GitHub stars, active development in the last z years, minimum Android version, etc.

We can't remove the ones that are already there because we may be breaking apps that are already using this API so we should leave them as is (and not remove then even if they are not actively maintained). 

By the same rationale, we don't want to expand the list too much because whatever entry we add will need to remain for the foreseeable future.. so I'll say, only add new entries that you actually need for your project. We'll take a need-based approach of only growing the list of reported distributions if a project actually needs a new entry for its logic.

Keeping the backward-compatibility need in mind, you should also revert the changes to the distribution names since current existing logic may rely on the current values.

Fair enough, in that case the only relevant changes of this PR are adding `ro.evolution.version` to 
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/b56a91878e7c94977e4af978968e41d0670c0a8b/platform/android/os_android.cpp#L297
and
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/b56a91878e7c94977e4af978968e41d0670c0a8b/platform/android/os_android.cpp#L323
